g.text: overloaded, api_error in a stream: worth asking again
400 usage limits, 429 spend cap, 402 billing: account limit
the resume time from Anthropic's sentence
asks again before any content, up to LLM_MAX_RETRIES

text.tspan: The provider names a failure's kind; the retrying client asks again only what is worth it and before any words, and turns an account limit into its own exception.
